$comment: Boneyard Rolodex — one card per salvageable part. Scan this BEFORE building any UI/visual from scratch; a part here may already do the job. When a build is killed, add its card here with its code under parts/.

cards.title: Coconut palm silhouette
cards.good_for: Any tropical/beach/vacation visual. Recolor via `fill`, scale via height/width, mirror a copy with transform: scaleX(-1) to frame.

cards.title: Warm golden-hour sunset background
cards.good_for: A drop-in sunset backdrop (sky + low sun + sea + glint + palm placement) for a future page that actually wants a depicted scene.
cards.from: Rejected because 72 wanted an abstract film, not a depiction

cards.title: Cool opal palette (periwinkle / lilac / blush)
cards.good_for: A calm, cool, spa/tech-y brand. Palette vars + a full-bleed sky→sea gradient.
cards.from: Rejected for 72 — read too cold/grey for a warm brand
